description: Retain the user-approved 1.4 conifer geometry and atlases, add four continuous side-mapped roots, supply six scaled/color tree items plus three center-dense folded grass items, and assemble native multipart trees through a guarded ordinary placement pipeline.
changes: Replace four old root boxes with sixteen curved segments using their corresponding trunk-side bark strip
Retain approved tree textures and crown; scale three sizes and keep normal/dark geometry identical
Replace full grass clump planes with 54 individual folded curved blades and six seed stems; center-bias root distribution
Expose nine complete inventory items with whole-plant handheld miniatures; hide twelve internal foliage items
Integrate native whole-tree placement and owned-part removal in the existing pack identifier; no periodic world scan
Remove obsolete prototypes from active library and Blockbench; preserve separate recovery archives
Ship JAR including plugin; verify rebuilding from library source reproduces all packaged entry bytes
advantages: One native placement action consumes one item and checks obstacles and cancelled events
Four root textures follow the corresponding bark side
All exported native components stay below 256 nodes
Final editor library and inventory contain only requested vegetation variants
disadvantages: Three internal blocks per tree require the bundled plugin and free anchor cells
Individual grass leaves are folded thin surfaces, not closed solid geometry
HD grass blades are generated interpretations of the approved reference, not original pixels
Final 1.5 client visuals and FPS remain user-reviewed; native technical checks are not visual approval
test_results: User explicitly approved 1.4 as the best result; this feedback does not pre-approve 1.5
180 create and 147 reload checks; 21 assets and 75 placed parts represent 27 whole objects
All six tree variants tested at four cardinal rotations; native positive 90 degrees maps +X to -Z
Ordinary placement consumes one, creative consumes none; obstruction and cancelled events prevent placement without consuming
Root removal clears matching owned foliage and preserves foreign edits
Full QA backup, five installed files verified; player/config hashes preserved, main map untouched
Rebuild content exactly matches distributed JAR: 176 entries
